name: fe-skillhouse
description: Jonathan Whiteley's collection of Claude Code plugins for Field Engineering workflows.

plugins.name: sa-transcript-tasks
plugins.description: Turn meeting transcripts into a markdown summary and confirmed Asana tasks. Account-agnostic; configure your own accounts, teammates, and Asana projects.

plugins.name: dbx-open-slide
plugins.description: On-brand Databricks slide decks as React code (open-slide): setup, authoring with the Databricks theme, render checks, and export to PPTX, PDF, HTML or Google Slides.
